_comment: Section -> view mapping for the generated Housing Needs Assessment views.
housing-needs-assessment.html stays the CANONICAL page and the full report:
it keeps every section, hna-export.js and print.css's A4 title-page margin,
so the PDF deliverable is unchanged. The views below are generated FROM it
by selecting sections, which is why no figure is ever authored twice.
Sections are matched on their <h2> text (prefix match, case-insensitive).
Every one of the 53 sections appears exactly once below, either in a view
or in 'shared'. The generator fails if that stops being true.
'review': true marks a placement I am not confident in -- these are the
editorial calls worth arguing about. Everything else is uncontroversial.

shared._why: Framing that every view needs. Repeated across views by design: it is generated, not authored, so it cannot drift.
